U.S. ARMY MOS 11B

11B Infantryman

ASVAB score requirements, what the job involves, and how to raise the scores that count

Minimum ASVAB score

  • CO 77

Minimum AFQT

31

What a 11B Does

Infantrymen are the Army's core ground fighters. You learn to move as part of a rifle team, handle rifles, machine guns and anti-armor weapons, patrol, and hold ground in every kind of terrain. Basic and job training happen together in one combined course, and the work is physically demanding from day one.

Scores That Count for 11B

  • CO (Combat) = AR + AS + MC. Study: Arithmetic Reasoning, Auto and Shop, Mechanical Comprehension

Army line scores average 100, and most people score between 60 and 140. Besides the main sections listed, the Army formula gives a small weight to your other sections too.

Other Requirements

  • Red/green color discrimination
  • Correctable vision of 20/20 in one eye and 20/100 in the other

Related Army Jobs

  • 11C Indirect Fire Infantryman CO 77
  • 19D Cavalry Scout CO 77
  • 12B Combat Engineer CO 82
  • 12N Horizontal Construction Engineer GM 85
  • 13B Cannon Crewmember GT 87
